blend.keeper: keeper mono_lith_01 + PROMO 'Get Your HALO' / F1 MONO/LITH

items.humor: Even a mountain gets a halo for the afterparty.
items.note: “Even a mountain gets a halo for the afterparty.” Grip = before: the bare monolith lying on calm straight op-art stripes, a striped hat-box at its foot with a hint of acid-yellow chrome inside. Flip = after: the monolith wears the dripping acid-yellow chrome halo like a too-small party hat and the stripes bulge around it. Glow window on the halo highlights, so the hat lights up at night. Card = deck daylight / night glow sim / grip. 300 dpi print PNGs on the box: /workspace/halo-output/catalog/build/B3_01_B1/B3_01_B1_deck_print.png and _grip_print.png (art upscaled from a 1280px render, about 45 dpi effective; hi-res re-render before any order).

items.title: Toasted Enlightenment · GLOW · 8.5 popsicle

blend.pin_trait: electric-blue marble statue against flat hot pink, hard studio light

items.note: “Enlightenment, lightly toasted.” Grip = before: the blue marble head lies asleep on hot pink, a chrome toaster lever pushed down, a gold seam glinting. Flip = after: the lid springs open and a clean acid-yellow chrome halo pops up like toast, steaming. Glow window on the halo highlights. Card = deck daylight / night glow sim / grip. 300 dpi print PNGs on the box: /workspace/halo-output/catalog/build/B3_03_B1/B3_03_B1_deck_print.png and _grip_print.png (art upscaled from a 1280px render, about 45 dpi effective; hi-res re-render before any order).

items.title: Signal Snack · GLOW · 8.5 popsicle

refs.label: Article idea · A5 cyberpunk glitch (pixel sort, scanlines)

blend.pin_trait: horizontal glitch stripe bands, RGB-split colour bars on black

items.note: “Signal received. Snack too.” Grip = before: static and an empty horizon, one pigeon waiting, a tiny yellow dot far off. Flip = after: a radio tower sends three clean acid-yellow chrome halo rings up into the dark; the top one has glitched into a pixel donut and the pigeon is eating it. Glow window on the ring highlights, so the rings wake at night. Card = deck daylight / night glow sim / grip. 300 dpi print PNGs on the box: /workspace/halo-output/catalog/build/B3_09_B1/B3_09_B1_deck_print.png and _grip_print.png (art upscaled from a 1280px render, about 45 dpi effective; hi-res re-render before any order).

changelog.text: catalog_v1: CAT_001–CAT_020 (20 pieces) to In Review — F1 Monument + F2 Open Head + F3 Matter Type start; decks/garments/posters/promos/social/stickers/lettering; tags/blend/source refs on cards
IBP_78_B1 Keep finals: Letter + 11x17 PDFs at 300 dpi (type rebuilt)
IBP_85 Keep finals: Letter + 11x17 PDFs (300 dpi); 18x24 box-only at 237 dpi honest

Wall cleanup: every voted/noted piece (items + update cards) moved to Archive, reason 'voted'. Only fresh unvoted pieces remain In Review. Cards show tags, Tapstitch blank refs and Boardpusher template refs.

catalog_v1 run 1 (3:33 PM MT): 11 required items published to In Review - decks B3_01_B1 Monolith Party Hat, B3_03_B1 Toasted Enlightenment, B3_09_B1 Signal Snack, B3_11 Breakfast of the Enlightened (Board Designs, blend pin/article/keeper on card); posters IBP_90_B1, IBP_91_B1, IBP_92_B1; REQ_RISEYOGA_A_v4 neobrutal; garments G_IBP_77, G_IBP_78_B1, G_IBP_80 on real Tapstitch blanks with lifestyle, product and print. Tags on every card.

Keep -> finals (4:31 PM MT run): IBP_79 Borrow the Night, IBP_80 Quiet Room / Loud Heart, IBP_81 Put Them On, IBP_82 Take a Seat in the Signal now have FINAL print PDFs (Letter + 11x17 landscape, 0.125 in bleed, true 300 dpi vector re-render) - download buttons and a Final files link on each archived card. G_IBP_78_B1 keep (#84) and front-heart note (#85) moved to Archive; its finals plus IBP_41_B2, IBP_66_R1, IBP_85, IBP_78_B1, IBP_12_B2 are upscaling in the background.

Keep -> finals: G_IBP_78_B1 Volume / Faith hoodie - FINAL DTF back PNG (4200x4500, 300 dpi, design 7.1x10.4 in) and a new left-chest front PNG (4x4 in) for the heart spot in Spirit's note #85; download buttons + Final files link on the archived card. A second upscale pass is queued to grow the back to full height.

Keep -> finals: IBP_12_B2 Chrome Heart / yellow HALO now has FINAL print PDFs (Letter + 11x17 landscape, 0.125 in bleed, true 300 dpi). The big HALO letters were rebuilt as real type at print size behind the 4x-upscaled chrome heart; download buttons and a Final files link on the archived card.
